content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through encapsulating jquery behavior with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns immediately invoked function expressions (iifes) into a repeatable implementation choice. Use small functions, scoped state, explicit initialization, and cleanup to prevent global namespace pollution and duplicate event handlers.
